home.title: Use up the AI coding plans you pay for
home.description: Subtrack shows what every Claude Code and Codex plan on your computer has left, tells you which account to use next, and prices your usage at API rates.

theme.label: Switch between light and dark theme

hero.title: Use up the AI coding plans you pay for
hero.lede: Subtrack watches every Claude Code and Codex login on your computer, shows what each plan’s 5-hour and weekly limits have left, and tells you which account to use next.
hero.note: Free and open source. macOS, Windows and Linux.

preview.label: Example of the Subtrack screens
preview.caption: Example figures. Plans and prices are the providers’ own.

features.title: Know what every plan has left, and which one to use

limits.title: Every limit at a glance
limits.text: The 5-hour and weekly windows of each Claude Code and Codex login, read from the providers themselves.

next.title: The account to use next
next.text: Ranked by headroom per hour before each reset, so the allowance that expires first gets used first.

value.title: Worth at API prices
value.text: Tokens counted from the CLIs’ own transcripts and priced per model, so you see what each plan is worth.

switch.title: Switch in one click
switch.text: Mark an account in use and the opt-in shell snippet points claude and codex in your terminal at it.

renewals.title: Renewals and waste
renewals.text: A calendar of when each plan bills, and how much paid allowance expired unused last month.

tray.title: Right in the tray
tray.text: The account to use next sits in your menu bar, refreshed every ten minutes in the background.

install.title: Install the desktop app
install.text: Subtrack finds the Claude Code and Codex logins already on your computer.

accounts.title: Add your other accounts
accounts.text: Each one signs into its own folder with the provider’s own CLI, so no login signs another out.

queue.title: Follow the queue
queue.text: Work on the account at the top until it runs low. The tray tells you when to switch.

privacy.title: Your logins never leave your computer
privacy.lede: Subtrack never refreshes a provider’s token, talks to each provider as itself (subtrack-desktop), and never replaces a status line you already have.

local.title: Stays on your computer
local.settings: Your shell and Claude settings, unless you opt in

api.title: Reaches Subtrack
api.tokens: Token counts per model and day

cta.title: Stop leaving paid limits on the table
cta.lede: Install Subtrack and see which of your accounts to use next in under a minute.

footer.label: Footer
footer.tagline: Limits, the account to use next and usage at API prices, for every Claude Code and Codex login on your computer.
footer.disclaimer: Not affiliated with Anthropic or OpenAI. Claude and Codex are their trademarks.
